name: Michael Reynolds
headline: Senior Business Development Manager - B2B SaaS Sales
summary: Results-driven Senior Business Development professional with 9 years of experience driving revenue growth in B2B SaaS environments. Proven track record of building strategic client relationships, negotiating complex enterprise deals, and leading cross-functional sales initiatives. Skilled in leveraging CRM platforms to optimize pipeline management and close rates.

responsibilities: Lead enterprise sales cycles from prospecting to close for mid-market and enterprise SaaS clients
Negotiate multi-year contracts with C-level stakeholders, achieving consistent quota attainment
Mentor and train junior sales representatives on consultative selling techniques
Manage and forecast sales pipeline using Salesforce, ensuring accurate reporting to leadership
Collaborate with marketing and product teams to align go-to-market strategies
Managed a portfolio of mid-market accounts, growing revenue through upselling and renewals
Built and maintained strong relationships with key decision-makers across target industries
Conducted product demonstrations and negotiated pricing agreements with prospective clients
Utilized Salesforce to track deal progress and maintain accurate forecasting
Prospected and qualified inbound and outbound leads for the enterprise sales team
Scheduled discovery calls and product demos with prospective B2B clients
Maintained CRM data accuracy and supported senior account executives during negotiations
